claims: Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess respiratory acidosis (pH 7.25-7.27, pCO2 54-55 mm Hg) and oxygenation on current oxygen support.
Assess need for ventilatory support or escalation of respiratory support given persistent hypercapnic acidosis and tachypnea/dyspnea on high-flow oxygen.
Monitor hemodynamics closely with arterial line given hypotension (ABP mean 84-89 mm Hg) and tachycardia (heart rate 99-103 bpm).
Continue epidural analgesia infusion (bupivacaine 0.1% at 11 mL/hr) and monitor pain control and sensory/motor function.
Continue PCA hydromorphone for pain management and monitor total dose, attempts, and sedation level.
Recheck serum magnesium given prior hypomagnesemia (1.5 mg/dL) and ongoing magnesium supplementation.
Recheck basic metabolic panel to monitor electrolytes, renal function, and acid-base status.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy as ordered for hyperglycemia (glucose 120-131 mg/dL).
Continue incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises to prevent pulmonary complications.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin as ordered.
